steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
Turn the ignition on with the engine off.
Press and hold the INFO and Reset buttons together to open the personalization menu.
If needed, press INFO to step through the menu until OIL LIFE RESET shows.
Press and hold the Reset button until ACKNOWLEDGED appears, then turn the ignition off.
oil.note: Checked in the 2009 Getting to Know Your HHR guide and the 2011 owner's manual. The 2011 manual also lists the accelerator pedal method for the 2.2L and 2.4L engines: ignition on, engine off, slowly press the pedal to the floor and release it three times within five seconds.

steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the Tire and Loading Information label on the driver's door pillar (cold means parked at least three hours or driven under a mile).
There is no reset button. The low tire pressure light stays on until the pressure is corrected, then goes off on its own.
The LOW TIRE message can be cleared for now with the display buttons, but it comes back at the next start if a tire is still low.
tpms.note: Checked in the 2009 Getting to Know Your HHR guide and the 2011 owner's manual. If the tire pressure light flashes for about a minute when you start the car and then stays on, the warning system itself has a fault. A reset won't fix it; have it checked.
